verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card issuing at scale (docs-2, docs-24), including issuing cards via AgentOS (docs-13). Its authorization controls let you set rules on how and where issued cards can be used (docs-3), and the corporate cards page advertises spend controls (docs-20), which covers the core of creating cards restricted to a purpose. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of virtual cards or instant creation, no specific documentation of merchant-category or single-vendor restrictions (e.g. ad platforms), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
